annotation.name: @no_mangle
annotation.description:
Marks the following named declaration as excluded from export-time mangling or rewriting done by wgodot. For constants and enums, only [annotation @no_mangle] on the constant or enum declaration itself prevents de-const/de-enum export processing from inlining values and removing metadata. Class/function/property [annotation @no_mangle] does not protect constant or enum usages inside that scope from being inlined. For classes, functions, and properties with getter/setter bodies, this acts recursively for name obfuscation of declarations inside that subtree. Usages inside the subtree still follow the declaration they reference; for example, a use of an outside private field is renamed if that outside field declaration is renamed. This annotation can be used on classes, constants, functions, enums, signals, and variables. It is also accepted on local constants and variables inside functions. [codeblock] @no_mangle const API_ENDPOINT = "https://example.com"
func example(): @no_mangle const DEBUG_LABEL = "debug" [/codeblock]

annotation.name: @no_string_mangle
@override
annotation.description: Marks the following instance method as intentionally overriding a method inherited from a base class. When [code]wgodot/gdscript/strict_override_checking[/code] is enabled, overriding an inherited method requires [annotation @override]. Marking a method that does not override any inherited method is an error. [codeblock] @override func _ready() -> void: pass [/codeblock]

annotation.name: @obfuscate
@obfuscate_path
annotation.description: Marks the following script class for export-time file path obfuscation when [code]wgodot/export/obfuscate_file_paths[/code] is enabled. The exported script file is renamed to a generated path, and string literals that exactly match the original [code]res://...gd[/code] script path are rewritten to the exported path. This is an explicit opt-in transform and does not rewrite dynamically assembled paths. The generated path uses [code]wgodot/export/obfuscate_file_paths_strategy[/code]. Binary-token exports write the script at the generated [code].gdc[/code] path without adding a runtime remap file. [codeblock] @obfuscate_path class_name HiddenLoader [/codeblock]

annotation.name: @partial
@private
@protected
@readonly
@static_class
annotation.description:
Marks the following class as a static utility class. Static classes cannot be constructed or used as type hints. They cannot use inheritance or interfaces, and their members must be static or constant. [codeblock] @static_class class MathHelpers: const SCALE = 100
static func percent(value: float) -> float: return value * SCALE [/codeblock]
